author: ReyCassie
body:
Dear Avicus staff,

i am am very sorry spawn killing and it will not happen again. During my ban I have learnt a lot and I am going to act much more mature now. Also I will try and not make it happen again as the signs are up to show where you can kill farm. I know I have been temp banned for spawn killing 3 times now but I have changed and would love to join back to your wonderful server as I love as so much. It is my favourite server, please give me another chance.

thanks for taking this into consideration 

from nemo

replies.body:
Hello,

It's a pretty awkward situation for you isn't it? Being known as the spawnkiller of Avicus...
I'm assuming you were spawn killing on Quintus when Pelp banned you, and you've been told where the limits are haven't you, don't deny it because I told you where the limits were and so have other mods before the redstone was added.
I'm afraid you're going to have to wait this ban out my friend as you just haven't learnt, I know what's been happening when no staff are on so you better make sure you contain your eager to spawnkill while you wait for your ban to expire.
-Denied

Regards,
Auratix
